## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Nashville, United States. It starts at 515 Opry Mills Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Katy Perry, Captain Kirk, Beyoncé and Obama, Johnny Depp and Johnny Cash - they're all waiting for you and your selfies inside Madame Tussauds Nashville. You'll also meet the lyrical legends who made American music so famous, right next to the Grand Ole Opry House.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €26.75. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 12 ratings and 6 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
